events.title: Omniscient confirms Vouch system activation and full reputation reset
events.description: Omniscient announced the new Vouch system will finally be activated, alongside a complete reputation reset; administrator reputation will no longer be visible. He is considering keeping a backup of old reputations to be viewable after reset.

events.title: The Mentors usergroup now moderates more subforums.
Administrator profile activity now hidden as 'Unknown location'
events.description: Administrator profile activity is now hidden; visitors only see 'Unknown location' on admin profiles.

events.title: Non-upgraded members can no longer use images in their signatures; l33t or Ub3r is required.
Tiny-Pic censored after Rhythm flags image-deletion behavior
events.description: Tiny-Pic, an image host that deletes images linked from HF, has been censored after Rhythm pointed out that uppit was already censored but Tiny-Pic was not.

events.title: Omniscient: PMing about Suggestions threads triggers repfuck and ban
events.description: Omniscient warned that PMing him to draw attention to a Suggestions and Ideas thread will get the account repfucked, banned, and 'ripped open like a can of tuna.'

events.title: User News is being moved to the Misc.
events.description: User News is being moved to the Misc. editions, and a new Opinion section is being added to the main edition where users can submit their thoughts on a weekly topic.
